data_source: AlgoSeek public Machine Learning for Trading companion minute bars
price_reference: TotalVolume-weighted TotalVolumeWeightPrice; same selected-window benchmark for both capacities

deadline_limit_diagnostic.status: Developed after the earlier EBAY/LULU pilot; fixed before evaluating this independent stock sample.
deadline_limit_diagnostic.formula: Q_max = min_j cap * sum(volume[j:]) / (1 - release_fraction[j-1]); previous fraction is 0 at j=0; skip zero denominators.
deadline_limit_diagnostic.scope: Fixed-fraction TWAP, historical and fixed_early only. Feedback fractions depend on Q; no such limit is reported.
deadline_limit_diagnostic.headroom_definition: Maximum fixed-schedule notional divided by the unchanged USD 1m order; not an ex-ante capacity promise.

corporate_actions.review: See the dated sample review and issuer sources in docs/protocol.md.
corporate_actions.adjustment: Provider prices and share volumes are used unchanged. Bundle adjustment flags were not independently certified; no additional adjustment was applied.

limitations: Four selected stocks from one historical quarter; fixed alpha=0.10 was not fitted on this sample.
Selected-window provider bar references exclude records assigned to 16:00; not auction-complete daily VWAP.
Reported volume coverage is not executable venue access. No routing, queue, spread, fees or own impact model.
Continuous share quantities and historical reference-price fills are approximations, not actual trades.
Price summaries use the intersection where all four methods complete under both capacity scopes.
Missing or invalid sessions are disclosed, not replaced. No profit or cross-market causal claim.
